content.comment_body: Hello, I am able to upload a program from [product_name] [version_no]. The file transfer completes, but nothing appears in the workspace—no program is shown. When I close the empty page, [product_name] [product_name] prompts me to save the program, even though it looks empty. Can someone assist?
Hello [user_name], could you provide more details? What is the [article_no] for your [product_name]? What firmware version does your [product_name] have? Which [product_name] version are you using?

If, after uploading, the workspace in [product_name] appears empty and no program is displayed, it likely means there is no actual program in the device. The save prompt appears because you performed actions that automatically trigger a save message, even if nothing is in the workspace.
Alternatively, with an Ethernet connection, you may also see an empty diagram. That's why I suggested you share the empty file for further review.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering issues where, after successfully uploading from [product_name] [version_no] using [product_name], the workspace remains empty and no program is shown. The software's prompt to save changes when closing the workspace adds to the confusion about whether the upload was successful.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that, after uploading from [product_name], the program will be immediately visible and accessible in the [product_name] workspace. They also expect clear feedback if no program is present or an error has occurred.
